summary: Verification-only run of NegoBuy Google (Emergent-managed) login wiring + email/password auth regression. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passed (/api/auth/google/session contract 401/422, login, /me bearer+unauth, refresh cookie, logout, wrong password). Frontend Playwright: 'Continue with Google' emits exactly https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<app-origin>/dashboard (no localhost/hardcoded origin); loading app at /dashboard#session_id=<v> synchronously renders AuthCallback with 'Establishing secure session…' (AuthContext correctly skips /auth/me), the exchange fires, backend returns 401 for the invalid session and the app redirects to /login; protected /dashboard redirects to /login when unauthenticated; admin email/password login lands on dashboard, session persists across reload, logout clears the token and returns to /login. No blocking issues found.

issues: Email/password fields are pre-filled with hardcoded demo credentials (buyer@test.com / test123) in Login.js state — convenient for testing but should be removed before production.

action_items: Optional: remove prefilled demo credentials from /app/frontend/src/pages/Login.js (useState defaults).

Optional: AuthCallback error text 'Google sign-in failed.' displays for <1.8s but was replaced quickly by navigation in automation; consider keeping the failure reason visible on /login (e.g. toast/query param) so users know why sign-in failed.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py google_session(): a Google-created user gets password_hash=None; login() already guards on missing password_hash, so no bypass — verified.

auth.py google_session(): data['email'] is accessed without a guard; if the Emergent session-data payload ever omits 'email' the endpoint would raise 500 instead of 401. Add a check (low risk, defensive).
Cookies use samesite=none; secure=True and the frontend also stores a Bearer token in localStorage — consistent across login/register/google paths.
seed_data_creation: None. No test users or missions created (admin seeded account reused).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google OAuth cannot be fully automated (real Google account blocked). Everything up to and around the Emergent session exchange is verified: outgoing redirect URL, hash-based AuthCallback routing, AuthContext /auth/me skip, and the 401 invalid-session path. Reusable regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_google_auth.py. Note /app/auth_testing.md does not exist in this workspace.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects reproduced. The reported Google login flow is correctly wired end to end at the routing and session-exchange layers.
